request.style: English, solemn female solo voice with soft choir, piano, strings, cello, harp, deep and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Hope does not put us to shame
God's love is poured into our hearts
Through the Spirit who has been given
For while we were still helpless
At just the right time Christ died
For the ungodly in that moment

[Chorus]
Rarely will anyone die
For a righteous or good person
But God proves his own love
While we were still sinners
Christ died for us

[Verse]
How much more since we are justified
By his blood we will be saved
Through him from God's wrath
If we were enemies before
Reconciled by the death of his Son

[Chorus]
Rarely will anyone die
For a righteous or good person
But God proves his own love
While we were still sinners
Christ died for us

[Bridge]
Having been reconciled to God
We will be saved by his life
Not only that but we boast
In God through our Lord Jesus Christ
Through whom we received reconciliation

[Chorus]
Rarely will anyone die
For a righteous or good person
But God proves his own love
While we were still sinners
Christ died for us

[Outro]
We boast in God
Through our Lord Jesus Christ
